records.source: A SUGGESTION IS JUDGED, NOT RELABELLED (item 512). A crop Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the key legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.

A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the structured-data name legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. records.translation: UNA SUGERENCIA SE JUZGA, NO SE REETIQUETA (elemento 512). Un recorte para el que Suggest propuso una clase lleva una insignia ámbar ``?`` junto a su anillo discontinuo. Un clic o ``Y`` la confirma (pasa a ser una etiqueta normal y lleva una marca verde); un clic derecho o ``N`` la rechaza (vuelve a quedar sin respuesta y lleva una cruz roja); ``U`` deshace cualquiera de las dos. Cada juicio se escribe en la columna ``<column>_verdict`` como ``+c`` o ``-c``, de modo que sobrevive a un reinicio, y a la siguiente ronda de Suggest se le entregan los rechazos para entrenar.
